hook_text: Phone on the fridge. Trumpet in hand.

song.title: Toot Toot
song.style: English, joyful brass band ska with trumpets, trombone, offbeat guitar and bouncy drums, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, rowdy gang vocals, 140 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Phone went quiet on the fridge
Found a trumpet, dusty, old
First note sounded like a goose
Second note was twice as bold

[Chorus]
Toot toot, here comes the band
Pots and pans and a helping hand
Toot toot, down the street
Everybody's got the beat

[Verse]
Kid next door brought out a drum
Grandpa brought his washboard too
Someone's dog began to howl
Now the whole block's playing through

[Chorus]
Toot toot, here comes the band
Nobody's scrolling, everybody stands
Toot toot, under the moon
We're terrible and right on tune

shots.prompt: {moss} blasts a shiny trumpet with puffed-out cheeks, and a flock of birds bursts out of a tree behind him. Low angle, static. Bright sunny light.

A finger gently taps the round pale yellow disc on a small rounded moss-green brick stuck to a white fridge door, a black smartphone standing upright inside it facing the wall. Warm light slowly shifts across the fridge. Static close-up.
{moss} lifts a dusty trumpet out of an old wooden box in the attic and blows the dust off, delighted. Static medium shot. Dusty sunbeams.
{moss} plays a squeaky note and a white goose next to him honks back, offended. Static medium shot. Warm afternoon light.
{moss} marches down the street playing his trumpet while a lanky teenage girl with a purple mohawk joins him banging a big drum. The camera tracks backward. Bright sunny light.
An old man with a long white beard plays a washboard while a floppy-eared dog howls along beside him. Static medium shot. Golden light.
{moss} leads a tiny parade of kids banging pots and pans down a leafy street. The camera tracks sideways. Late afternoon gold.
Neighbors dance in the street under strings of warm lights as {moss} plays his trumpet. The camera circles slowly. Warm evening glow.

{moss} sits on a curb under the moon with a lanky teenage girl with a purple mohawk and the old man, all laughing, the trumpet in his lap. The camera slowly pulls back. Deep blue and warm amber, calm.

caption: Moss tapped the eye on his Hibernator and found an old trumpet. He is terrible. The whole block joined anyway.
